answer_1.quote: We propose the novel task of jointly repairing code and generating commit message.

answer_2.quote: For the code repair, we use exact match accuracy to measure the percentage of the predicted fixed code that are exactly matching the truth fixed code. In addition, we also introduce the BLEU-4 score as a supplementary metric to evaluate their partial match. For the commit message generation, we use BLEU-4 and Rouge-L to evaluate our model.
